purpose: Prediction robustness extension only. This registration does not replace the registered Phase 2 association model or the Phase 3 land-change analysis.
research_question: Do prior-calendar-year AlphaEarth embeddings improve out-of-time ranking of fire-positive cells within the existing exact 1:4 daily matched sets beyond the registered explicit environmental covariates?

allowed: heterogeneity in prediction performance across spatial blocks
prohibited: causal attribution to government action, drought, peat drainage, or plantations
replacement of the registered Phase 2 effect estimates
use of an embedding value from the event year or a future year
publication of a nationwide risk surface before locked-test validation

target.name: viirs_fire_positive_within_exact_daily_matched_set
target.unit: one candidate cell within a five-cell exact daily matched set

alphaearth_source.attribution: Google Satellite Embedding dataset, produced by Google

temporal_lock.reason: An annual embedding can contain post-fire surface information from its calendar year. A one-year lag prevents that direct temporal leakage.

extraction.geometry: existing exact 1-km analysis cell polygon reconstructed from the private grid index
extraction.post_reduction_transform: row-wise L2 normalization of the 64-dimensional mean vector
extraction.missingness: drop the entire matched set if any required embedding dimension is missing or non-finite
extraction.public_output_policy: never publish row-level embeddings or coordinates

validation.spatial_group: 100-km block derived from the equal-area grid; all rows for a cell remain in one group
validation.minimum_required_improvement: combined model must improve locked-test conditional log loss over the explicit-covariate model; uncertainty interval will also be reported
validation.locked_test_access: one final evaluation after model and penalty selection are frozen on development and rehearsal data

models.baseline: registered explicit-covariate conditional logistic scoring model
models.embedding_only: L2-regularized conditional logistic scoring model using A00-A63
models.combined: L2-regularized conditional logistic scoring model using explicit covariates plus A00-A63
models.selection_rule: lowest mean spatial-group cross-validated conditional log loss on development years; ties choose the larger penalty
models.overfit_guard: report n, p, p/n, spatial-group count, fold stability, and coefficient norm; do not add nonlinear learners until this linear ablation passes

stopping_rules: Stop and revise extraction if the feature gate rejects any required feature.
Stop if a requested embedding year differs from event_year - 1.
Stop if any event-year split differs from this registration.
Do not reinterpret a predictive gain as causation.
Do not update the public dashboard until the locked-test audit and reproducibility checks pass.
